frauxsearch-query-invalid-encoding: Error shown when a full-text search query is not valid UTF-8.
frauxsearch-query-escaped-quote: Error for a backslash followed by a double quotation mark in a full-text query. The backend cannot escape quotation marks inside a quoted phrase.
frauxsearch-query-unclosed-quote: Error for an unmatched double quotation mark in a full-text query.
frauxsearch-query-empty-clause: Error for a missing term after a unary sign, repeated unary signs, or an empty quoted phrase. Keep the literal + and - syntax characters.
frauxsearch-query-unsupported-operator: Error for an unsupported search operator. $1 is the literal operator, such as intitle:, OR, *, or ~. Keep -word as an example of excluding a term.
